description:
## Goal

Publish each identical (callee activation, input row) contribution at most once per AnalyzeActivation conclusion.

## Evidence

merge_call_emission deduplicates the Activation FactKey but not activation_input_contributions. Measured at origin/main a3a9761d1, identical rows repeat up to 26 / 3 / 12 times in one conclusion on enum_take_drop_split, range_map, and predicate targets; 200 / 13 / 141 conclusions emit at least two duplicates. Every duplicate reaches addressing, antichain comparison, sorting, joining, and row-budget accounting.

## Strategy and proof

1. Add a temporary count asserting the current duplicate population.
2. Deduplicate at the emission boundary before normalization/publication, using exact semantic row identity.
3. Preserve distinct publishers and distinct input evidence; do not collapse merely equivalent rows whose ownership differs.
4. Require one emitted row per identical contribution and byte-identical facts, products, backend/native artifacts, and runtime output.
5. Compare activation-input join calls, row-budget pressure, and causal work before/after; remove the temporary counter and proof-only fixture metadata.
6. Run focused semantic tests, full library, fixture matrix, determinism, formatting, and strict clippy.

This is a local duplicate-work deletion, not an antichain or activation-key policy change.

Deleting the blend measured 0 behaviour movers / +48 executables. This ticket dedups identical rows at the same boundary; 188 deletes a fabricated one. Land on one pass over the emission boundary.

Conclusion-local exact identity dedup at AnalyzeActivation emission makes max multiplicity 1 and attempted==distinct, preserving first occurrence, distinct rows, and publisher scope. Temporary census/probe metadata removed. A/B: canonical backend, CLIF, and runtime stdout byte-identical on all three fixtures; public causal dimensions/products unchanged, uncaused and undefined-first-use zero. Raw native debug dumps are intentionally non-canonical and differ even base-vs-base, so CLIF is the stable native artifact proof. Gates: focused tests green; cargo test --lib 1596 passed/5 ignored; fixture_matrix serial 485/9; fz2_cli 25/0; workspace all-target/all-feature check green; clippy -D warnings green; fmt/diff checks green. Two-file uncommitted diff (semantic.rs + semantic-fixpoint docs) is ready for cold review.

Cold-review proof gap closed: the helper-only unit was removed. The permanent test now drives a source fixture through the production semantic pipeline, runs and completes actual AnalyzeActivation conclusions, and asserts ordered raw contributions: repeated sink/list(int) removed; other/list(int) retained under a distinct key; sink/list(atom) retained under the same recursive convergence key. It then replaces first/0's lowered body with a no-call body, signals LoweredBody movement, proves the first AnalyzeActivation job rebased, runs/completes that actual empty contribution conclusion, and only then runs/completes second/0's actual conclusion; second independently emits and owns the identical sink/list(int) contribution and keeps the shared facts published. Superseded helper/scaffolding absent. Reruns: focused production-boundary + contribution withdrawal/frontier ownership tests green; full lib 1596 passed/5 ignored; strict all-target/all-feature clippy green; fmt/diff/residue checks green. Production implementation remains the same minimal conclusion-local exact set, now inlined at its sole use.
